notes: Derived edit through the transitivity of part_of (the premise "a part of an organ is part of every organ system the organ belongs to" is that property). Since 2026-11-01 the record's firm bridges are 'Neither the nephron nor any of its parts belongs to both the urinary system and the respiratory system' (one_system, over the named structures nephron and glomerulus) and 'Every organ system the nephron belongs to contains the organ the nephron is part of' (organ_carries_system, a rule). w1 gives up nephron_kidney and puts the nephron in some other organ (a placeholder); w2 gives up kidney_urinary and adds nothing. q0's respiratory answer follows from the edit and organ_carries_system in both worlds, not from an add. (Until 2026-11-01 one_system said the nephron and its parts each belong to one organ system, and each world added a placeholder system for the organ, which that rule equated with the respiratory system; the one-system claim was disputable, CRITERIA Rule 1.)
